## What problem does this solve?

Describe the use case, not just the feature — what are you trying to do that the tool doesn't currently support?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see added or changed?

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're using today, or other approaches you considered.

## Additional context

Check `docs/roadmap.md` first — is this already planned? If so, feel free to just +1 the relevant section instead of filing a duplicate.
